body:
The condition of your credit decides whether you walk away with $20,000 in funding or $400,000, even a million across multiple businesses, plus personal funding if you want it.

Your score is only part of that. Small details in your file, like your personal data and your business codes, hold back even 800 scores from the MAXIMUM amount of funding.

And there's one step most people miss that makes the biggest difference of all. ↑

I'm Chris, I run Fundhub. I learned the funding game ten years ago, and I've funded a little over $1 million for myself since then.

When a bank denies you and never tells you why, nobody checked your file against what that bank approves.

When someone sends your file to every lender on their list, you walk away with two approvals and a report full of hard inquiries.

And when you skip applying because you don't want a hard pull, you never find out what you qualify for.

All three come from the same mistake. Nobody checks your file against what each bank approves before the applications go out.

Our underwriting software, UnderwriteIQ, catches those small details before anything goes out, so we fix them first.

Then it matches your file against thousands of lenders to find the 30 to 50 that fit you, and we apply in funding rounds, in the order that protects your score.

Credit cards are where most people start, and we also get you lines of credit, SBA loans, merchant cash advances and personal funding, stacked together at the lowest rates.

Here's the step most people miss. ↑ Every application leaves a hard inquiry, and when the next round goes out with those still on your report, the next lender approves less.

So we remove the inquiries between EVERY round. Your file goes into each round clean, and that's how a funding sequence runs 3 to 6 rounds and builds real capital.

We're the only company in this industry that runs your file this way.

Most of the people we work with are aiming for $250,000 to $400,000. Some files are ready for that today, and a lot aren't yet, which is completely normal.

Wherever your file is right now, Fundhub has a solution for that phase.

If your file is ready, we go get the capital. A funding advisor starts on your file within 24 business hours, and your first applications go out within 72.

If you qualify and we can't fund you, you don't pay.

If something on your report is holding you back, we show you exactly what it is, optimize your credit for you, and fund you once your file is ready.

And if you'd rather do the work yourself, that's the Capital Blueprint. It puts your file through the 13 optimization points in the order that actually gets you funded.

It tells you which balances to bring down and by how much, which negative items to get removed, and what to add to your file to make it stronger.

It shows you which banks to build relationships with, where to keep your deposits, and how to set up your business data so banks see a company they trust.

Every step comes with a timeline, and as you finish each one, you see your fundability climb toward the maximum.

You learn funding by doing it on your own file, with an advisor checking in and answering your questions the whole way.

We GUARANTEE it's the last tool you'll need to learn the funding game, and when your file is ready, we go get the funding with you.

We've worked hundreds of files and collected thousands of data points on what lenders approve, so we know exactly what your file qualifies for.

Click the button below, fill out the 10-second application, and pick a time for your call.

Your advisor meets with you on a Google Meet and runs a 3-bureau report. You pay $32, and there's no impact on your score.

You'll see how much you qualify for based on where you're at right now, what's holding your file back, and the fastest way to the maximum amount of funding.

If you've been told no before, or you just want to know what's possible, this call is where you find out. Click the button below and book your call.

Making a million dollars takes TWO things, a proven investment and access to capital.

You might have good credit and a high income and still be MISSING the second one.

Maybe you've paid cash your whole life, or you've got credit you never use. Or maybe you have an old LLC or a company you forgot about.

That company is worth a LOT of money to a bank.

You built your income by being a professional and managing money well, and that's EXACTLY why banks want to lend to you. I'm not going to tell you where to put the money, but here's what capital does in the right hands.

Every dollar I put into Meta comes back about FOUR times, and that's on the low end, so $200,000 run through a system that already has proven returns turns into a LOT more than $200,000.

Capital lets you grow on a proven system MUCH faster than cash flow ever will.

Here's what that company you forgot about is worth. ↑

Every business qualifies for funding on its own, and the older the business is, the MORE capital it gets, just from having that age. One business is $100,000 at a minimum, and an older one gets up to $300,000.

So look at the businesses you have that you aren't using.

If you have one, that's up to $300,000. If you have two, that's up to $600,000, and if you have THREE, that's up to $900,000, sitting in your account in the next 15 to 30 days, depending on what your roadmap takes to get you there.

Then ask yourself ONE question. ↑

Do you want access to that capital to put into the proven system you already make money with? ↑

If the answer is yes, book a call below, and your advisor will show you what your file and every one of your companies are worth to a bank right now.

If the answer is no, keep doing what you're doing.

You can spend the next year figuring out how credit turns into money, or you can get my last TEN years of it on one call.

Paying off a card and CLOSING it.

When you close a card, you lose years of history you can't buy back, and you lose that limit with it. Close a $20,000 card and every approval after it comes in $20,000 to $40,000 SMALLER, because banks size you off the limits you already have.

When you work with us, our system catches costly moves like that BEFORE they ever happen, so you get the maximum amount of funding and keep access to capital whenever you want it, for the rest of your life.

I learned every one of those moves the hard way so you don't have to. Click below and book a call, and your advisor will go through your file with you.

body:
The bank behind me already decided how much they'd give you, and how much money you make barely factors into it.

One thing on your credit report decides it, and it outweighs your income and your score.

A guy making three hundred thousand dollars a year with perfect payment history gets approved for eight thousand dollars, while his buddy making half that walks out of the same bank the same week with eighty. Same bank, same week, and the only real difference between them is one thing on their credit reports.

It's been on your report for years, and it sets your approvals every time you apply. Fixing it is a simple tweak, and once you do, every approval after that comes in bigger.

It's your highest limit card. Banks look at the biggest limit another bank has already given you, and they'll approve you for one to two times that amount depending on the bank. The guy with eighty thousand had a big limit on his report, and the guy with eight didn't.

Click the link below. Your highest limit is one of 13 things on your file that decide how much you get, and your advisor will walk you through the other 12 so you can maximize your fundability.

video: Direct Book Ad 10 — Scale without your own cash
body:
Putting MORE money into your business is the fastest way to stop running out of cash.

And you can do it without using your own cash. ↑

Here's what I found scaling my own businesses. Jeremy Haynes, one of the biggest names in ads, explains this all the time. When your business is stuck with limited cash, you have to turn your spending UP. More spend gets you more data, your ads perform better, and you can finally pay for the people and tools that help you break free.

Maybe your business makes $10,000 a month, maybe $20,000 a month, maybe $50,000 a month. Or maybe you don't have a business yet and you're looking to start one. Wherever you're starting, if you want to get past $100,000 a month, you need capital to get there.

I'm in my early 30s, and I know how hard it is to build real freedom on limited capital. It's hard to save for retirement, and it's even harder to buy back the time with your family that you missed the last few years while you were grinding on your business.

Everybody knows it. I know it, because I've been there. Sometimes you're not taking the right action, and sometimes you just don't have enough capital to take the right action.

You already know what your business needs. Maybe you don't have the money to do it. Or maybe you have the money, but it's your savings, and you don't want to risk it. ↑

Your family wants you to take that leap. Your mom, your brother, your sister, your son, your daughter. They want to see you win, and they want more of your time when you do.

The hard part is that the savings you'd use to take that leap are the same savings that keep your family safe. Funding lets you take the leap and keep that safety net right where it is.

Mark Zuckerberg said, "The biggest risk is not taking any risk."

You might not be ready to take that risk yet, and that's okay. But start getting ready NOW. The economy is getting harder for entrepreneurs. Interest rates just went up, banks are giving out less money, and the business owners who get ready FIRST are the ones who still get funded.

Here's the plan, and one step in it took me years of driving bank to bank to figure out. ↑

Step one, fix up your credit FIRST. If it's not with me, do it with somebody. I want you to win either way. Just get it right.

Step two, open your businesses and build their credit. If you have extra cash, buy an older company. Those are assets banks will fund. Your personal credit is the main one, and every business you add MULTIPLIES it.

Step three is the one that took me years. You need to know exactly which banks fit your credit profile and your business profile, and apply to them in the right order. ↑

I used to drive to every single bank in my state to learn what each one looks for. You'll learn a lot doing that, and it's worth doing. But it takes a TON of time when you also have a business to run. That's time away from your business and your family, and it makes everything harder.

Working with someone who already knows every bank and every detail they look for saves you all of that time.

Once you have that plan, you have everything you need to get funded. If you feel confident doing it yourself, go do it. Or work with someone who's done this their whole career. That's the plan while interest rates rise.

And that's how you scale without touching your own cash. We get you funding on your credit and your businesses, so you put that money into growth, your cash stays right where it is, and you finally get the freedom and the time back that you've been working for.

Click the link below, and your advisor will walk you through the plan for where your credit is right now and show you how much funding you can get to grow your business.

The guys up there figured out one thing that nobody seems to talk about. Your parents won't tell you, your friends won't, maybe not even your business partner, and you won't find it online.

When I used to live here, I knew a guy up there with a $1.5 million penthouse, and he was struggling. He was struggling mentally to get his businesses and his other ventures off the ground, sitting in a penthouse he owned outright.

So he moved out of state and cut out the distractions. He optimized his credit, then put it to work alongside investors and credit partners, and within six months his income was over $400,000 a year.

The one thing he figured out is how to leverage your credit correctly. I know plenty of people up here who run companies and scale businesses, and the ones who do it most efficiently use other people's money. Archimedes said, "Give me a lever long enough and I can move the world." Credit is that lever, and building with only your own cash is the slowest way to build wealth there is.
